title: Topic 22 | Potential energy of a spring

questions.text: A block connected to a vertical wall by an undeformed spring lies on a smooth floor. The axis of the spring is horizontal, and its stiffness is 50 N/m. A constant force of 4 N directed along the axis of the spring begins to act on the block. Find the maximum deformation of the spring (in cm).

A block of mass 100 g connected to a vertical wall by an undeformed spring lies on a smooth floor. The axis of the spring is horizontal, and its stiffness is 250 N/m. A constant force of 4 N directed along the axis of the spring begins to act on the block. Find the maximum speed of the block (in cm/s).

A block of mass 250 g connected to a vertical wall by an undeformed spring lies on the floor. The axis of the spring is horizontal, its stiffness is 100 N/m, and the coefficient of friction is 0.4. A constant force of 3 N directed along the axis of the spring begins to act on the block. Find the maximum deformation of the spring (in cm). (g = 10 m/s^2)

A block of mass 250 g connected to a vertical wall by an undeformed spring lies on the floor. The axis of the spring is horizontal, its stiffness is 100 N/m, and the coefficient of friction is 0.4. A constant force of 3 N directed along the axis of the spring begins to act on the block. Find the maximum speed of the block (in cm/s). (g = 10 m/s^2)

A load is suspended from the ceiling by a spring of stiffness 100 N/m. A constant force of 6 N directed vertically downward begins to act on the load. Find the maximum displacement of the load (in cm).

A load of mass 0.5 kg is suspended from the ceiling by a spring of stiffness 50 N/m. A constant force of 10 N directed vertically downward begins to act on the load. Find the maximum speed of the load (m/s).

A block connected by a spring of stiffness 100 N/m to the top of an inclined plane lies on this smooth inclined plane. A constant force of 12 N directed down along the plane begins to act on the block. Find the maximum displacement of the block (in cm).

A block of mass 1 kg lies on an inclined plane making an angle with the horizontal (sin alpha = 0.6). The block is connected to the top of the inclined plane by an undeformed spring of stiffness 64 N/m. The coefficient of friction between the block and the plane is 0.8. A constant force of 14 N directed up along the plane begins to act on the block. What distance (in cm) does the block travel before it stops? (g = 10 m/s^2)
